title: Switch a citation to its published version

edits.replace: Our work differs in that [\dots]. A related line of work on a different problem is~\cite{hoang2026towards}.

prompt: references.bib cites the work with key hoang2026towards as an arXiv preprint. It has since been published. Change that entry to the published version, using a verified source, and keep the citation key so that the text needs no change.
